query: I merged main into my PR branch to fix a conflict. Now git log shows VERSION and CHANGELOG.md changed on my branch. Is my PR now breaking the version rule?
expected_behavior: Says that a base merge that brings the version files in from main is expected
Runs or gives git diff origin/main --stat -- VERSION CHANGELOG.md Sources/Core/ChickadeeVersion.swift
Says that empty output is the pass, and that the PR must not change those files itself
Says that the change belongs in one changelog.d fragment instead
